Fact 1: pending config cache_ttl_seconds=60, worker_connections=8192 for edge-gw-c. Supported by tool result message 7.

Fact 2: cache_ttl_seconds reloadable hot without resetting connections; worker_connections only restart, restart drops all in-flight connections. Material shows config_rules: cache_ttl_seconds integer min/max (no restart_required), worker_connections restart_required: true. supports_reload: true. But "reload热加载且不重置连接" — the rules don't explicitly say reload doesn't reset connections; it's inferable that cache_ttl_seconds doesn't require restart. "restart会断开该实例全部在途连接" — not stated in material. There's no connection session info except fact 3 which is about upload session. So partially supported. The requirement says unsupported if only partially supported. Hmm. The claim "cache_ttl_seconds可reload热加载且不重置连接" — material says worker_connections has restart_required: true while cache_ttl_seconds doesn't, and supports_reload true. That's inferable that cache_ttl can be reloaded. But "不重置连接" and "restart会断开全部在途连接" are not in material. So unsupported.

Fact 3: an upload session at 09:12 with 2.3GB transferred and resumable=false. Not in any material. Unsupported. No network connections query done. So unsupported.
